comments.body:
polysnack has amazing pizzas. best mensa at eth no doubt. 

rice up at the hb.

zuri bistro has doner+drink for like 12 or so chf during lunch. 

chopstick, niederdorfli. you can get a ton of fried rice/noodles for not a lot (remember this is Zurich)

New Bombay is an Indian restaurant in niederdorfli that has a 21chf unlimited lunch buffet. There's a few other such indian/Pakistani places around eth.
comments.author: iam_thedoctor
